case: The operator requires question 1 to be established (amend --must-establish, which makes no new revision); its answer is not determinable on a coverage record another seat reviewed, which is a disposition under the ordinary bar; question 2 is established and attested.
design: docs/adr/0013 'A question that must be established': the operator requires it on an existing question by amendment; a reviewed not determinable is no disposition for it, under every stop policy; readiness holds it as the done does.
docs/adr/0013 'The end of a run, under every stop policy': a reviewed not determinable ends any other question's run examination-limited.
docs/adr/0017 addendum 'Measuring a rule change': readiness, the answers check and the finish gate never disagree on a question.
